exposure: Patients with major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) vs. without MACE
outcome: Major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) including death, heart failure, thrombo-embolic events, and arrhythmia
finding: Although most women with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy tolerated pregnancy well, cardiovascular complications were not uncommon and were predicted by pre-pregnancy NYHA functional class and signs of heart failure, facilitating pre-pregnancy counseling and targeted antenatal care.
mod_finding: Women with MACE had a higher rate of emergency Cesarean delivery for cardiac reasons.
